info.title: Amazon Bedrock Runtime Auth Overlay
info.description: Corrects the authentication scheme for the Amazon Bedrock Runtime API. Bedrock now supports long-lived API keys passed as an HTTP Bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`), in addition to AWS SigV4. The base spec modelled auth as a raw `apiKey` header named `Authorization`, which forced callers to type the `Bearer ` prefix into the credential value themselves. This overlay removes the raw `apiKey` scheme and replaces it with a proper HTTP bearer scheme so the `Bearer ` prefix is applied automatically. The scheme key is renamed to `bearerAuth`, and the root `security` requirement is updated to reference it.

bearerAuth.description: Amazon Bedrock API key, sent as an HTTP Bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`). Bedrock also accepts AWS Signature Version 4; use a SigV4-capable credential for that path.
